The UK's productivity problem may not be quite as bad as we have thought, because the Office of National Statistics has been under-estimating productivity increases (by over-counting employment)... does this indicate things are not quite as bad as the Starmer administration believed them to be?

If the re-calculation is right then of course the next Q. is where have the over-counted (now) non-workers gone?

Unemployed? unpaid care?

#politics #productivity
